items.question: You will receive a ------- e-mail from the Nicoya Hotel verifying your travel plans within two hours of making your reservation.
items.answer_explain: 后文 verifying your travel plans 说明这封邮件用于核实预订和行程，因此是 confirmation e-mail，选 B。A sponsor 指赞助者；C margin 指边缘、余量或利润率；D permit 指许可证，均不符合酒店预订后发送确认信息的场景。
items.question_translation: 预订完成后的两小时内，您将收到 Nicoya 酒店发来的**确认**邮件，核实您的出行安排。
items.grammar_point: 名词作定语：confirmation e-mail（确认邮件）

explanation_structured.grammar_point: 名词作定语：confirmation e-mail（确认邮件）
